name: Malakir
description: The vampire city on Guul Draz, divided among five families.

description_citations.text: "Vampire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bloodchief Tenihas is murdered in his bedroom; the only witness swears Anowon did it and vanished.
timeline.quote: The only surviving witness swore that Anowon had killed his bloodchief in a fit of rage and then vanished.

citation.text: "Anowon", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Zendikari vampires fall into civil war as the Eldrazi escape; the Ghet seize holdings and Drana retakes Malakir before being driven out.
timeline.quote: Drana struck back, retaking control of Malakir and driving Kalitas and his traitors away from the city.

citation.text: "Vampire", section "Civil War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
